title: No test proves sign-out is held while saved items still wait to send
what: Staff and sign-in turns the sign-out button off while things saved on this device have not reached the server, so a payment is not lost. No automated test saves something offline and then tries to sign out.
expected: A test saves a payment with no internet, opens Staff and sign-in, and checks sign-out is off with the wait-for-All-sent words, then on once sent.
how_often: every sign-out with a weak connection
fix_line: Add one end-to-end test for sign-out with items waiting

title: Removing a person is tested only on the happy path
what: The only test removes one desk person once. Nothing checks the person already removed from another device, a double tap, Cancel leaving the person in place, the owner row having no Remove button, or adding a removed person back with a fresh code.
expected: Tests cover the already-removed words, one call per tap, Cancel changing nothing, no Remove on the own row, and re-adding a removed person.
fix_line: Add the five missing cases to the people test

title: No test proves the gym records leave the device after sign-out or removal
what: Tests check the welcome page and its words after a sign-out or a removal, but none checks that members, payments and the gym name are no longer kept on the device, nor what happens to items still waiting to send.
expected: A test signs out (and one removes the person) and checks the device copy of the gym is gone, and unsent items are not dropped without a word.
who: owners, front desk and members whose details sit on a shared computer
how_often: every sign-out on a shared device
fix_line: Add a check of the device copy after sign-out and after removal

title: The signed-out notice is never tested with no internet, a second tab, or a later sign-in
what: Tests show the signed-out and removed words once on one tab. None checks the words when the reason cannot be asked offline, a second tab following the sign-out, the notice going away after signing in again, or showing once only.
expected: Tests cover the offline reason, a second tab, the notice cleared after sign-in, and one notice per sign-out.
how_often: each time someone is signed out
fix_line: Add tests for the offline, two-tab and after-sign-in cases

title: No test signs in as a trainer
what: Every sign-in, PIN and sign-out test uses the owner or a plain front desk person. A trainer (a desk person with the Trainer tick) never signs in, sets a PIN or signs out in any test, so a change that treats trainers differently would not be caught.
expected: At least one test signs a trainer in with a code, sets a PIN, checks the pages they see, and signs out.
fix_line: Add one trainer sign-in journey to the end-to-end tests

title: The Change my PIN sheet is tested only for the owner, and the locked words never
what: Only the owner opens Change my PIN in a test. The staff version, with its own "ask your gym owner" forgot words, is never opened, and the "Your PIN is locked till" card line is never shown in any test.
expected: Tests open Change my PIN as a desk person and check its words, and show the locked line after five wrong tries.
how_often: when a PIN is changed or locked
fix_line: Add a desk Change my PIN test and a locked-card check

title: The Create my gym no-answer path is tested only as words
what: When Create my gym gets no answer, the form offers Sign in instead with the number filled. Only the words are unit tested. No test drives the button, checks the number carries over, or that trying again does not make a second gym.
expected: An end-to-end test drops the answer, taps Sign in instead, checks the number, signs in to the gym that was made, and checks one gym only.
how_often: on a slow connection at sign-up
fix_line: Add one end-to-end test for the no-answer path

title: No test changes the number after it was checked, or uses a run-out check on Create my gym
what: Tests check a used proof is refused by the server. No screen test changes the mobile after "Number checked", or shows "This check has run out" with a button to check again.
expected: Tests change the number after the check and see the check go, and see the run-out words with the button to check again.
how_often: when a sign-up is slow or the number is retyped
fix_line: Add the two cases to the WhatsApp sign-up test

title: No test proves the PIN, code or mobile stay out of the address bar and browser storage
what: Server tests prove the PIN is never sent back. No panel test looks at the address bar, local storage or the device copy after typing a PIN, a code or a mobile at sign-in, sign-up or Forgot your PIN.
expected: A test signs in, signs up and resets a PIN, then checks the address and browser storage hold no PIN, code or typed mobile.
fix_line: Add a storage and address check to the sign-in tests

title: The support window is never shown on screen after its hour ends
what: The server test proves reads stop after an hour. The screen test closes the window early only. No test lets the hour pass and checks the card stops offering Close it now, or checks a double tap opens one window.
expected: A test opens a window, moves the clock past the hour, and checks the card shows the past window and the open button again; and one window per double tap.
fix_line: Add a clock-past-the-hour step to the access test
